description: :cookie: Simple cross-browser cookie-consent plugin written in vanilla js

latest_release.name: cookieconsent v3.3.0
latest_release.body:
## Features
* add an exports map and a default export to the ESM build by @orestbida in https://github.com/orestbida/cookieconsent/commit/2595fc0cea4ce8c229d5f323b6743595400539d1

## Bug fixes
* page scroll lock regression with the root option by @orestbida in https://github.com/orestbida/cookieconsent/commit/588e20ce6144ac31d3ece18de5c769f884a0ea64
* append the modal to `<body>` by default (close #841) by @orestbida in https://github.com/orestbida/cookieconsent/commit/be3b07e7d9b7a01f050d2d3f7de1542331697c3f
* reset svg, label and caption styles from the host page by @orestbida in https://github.com/orestbida/cookieconsent/commit/4618ae19b28fcbc90ddcca614f14f10f6057777e
* hide the arrow icon on sections that can't expand by @orestbida in https://github.com/orestbida/cookieconsent/commit/d6a4aef185463a1ef8862a91873d096f9fc236b1

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/orestbida/cookieconsent/compare/v3.2.1...v3.3.0
